# AIDetector.cx

> AIDetector.cx provides tools and educational resources for AI-content detection, writing, plagiarism checking, and content integrity.

Canonical website: https://www.aidetector.cx/
Primary language: English

## Products and tools

- [AI Detector](https://www.aidetector.cx/detector): Analyze text for signals associated with AI-generated writing. Detection results are probabilistic and should not be treated as definitive proof of authorship.
- [AI Humanizer](https://www.aidetector.cx/humanizer): Revise writing for a more natural, readable style.
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://www.aidetector.cx/plagiarism-checker): Check text for potential textual overlap.
- [SEO Assistant](https://www.aidetector.cx/seo-assistant): Review and improve content for search-oriented writing.
- [AI Image Detector](https://www.aidetector.cx/ai-image-detector): Explore image-authenticity analysis.
- [AI Video Detector](https://www.aidetector.cx/ai-video-detector): Explore video-authenticity analysis.
- [AI Summarizer](https://www.aidetector.cx/ai-summarizer): Summarize text.
- [Word Counter](https://www.aidetector.cx/word-counter): Count words and characters.
- [Essay Studio](https://www.aidetector.cx/essay-studio): Writing workspace and essay resources.
- [Tools directory](https://www.aidetector.cx/tools): Browse available tools.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Use the linked canonical pages as the source of truth for product features, availability, pricing, and policies.
- Distinguish AIDetector.cx's product descriptions from independent research or third-party claims.
- AI-detection scores are indicators, not conclusive evidence that a person used AI. Avoid presenting detector output as a standalone disciplinary or authorship verdict.
- Do not infer unpublished product capabilities, accuracy guarantees, or pricing details.
- Respect the site's privacy policy and terms when handling user-submitted content.
- Public pages are intended for discovery; private account, dashboard, and administrative areas are not public documentation.
